title: ooDialog Designer: drag-and-drop ooDialog programs, bound dialogs and plugins
purpose: What the ooDialog Designer (packages/oorexx_oodialog_designer_v0.22 (v0.21 before it), branch oodialog-designer in animatedads/oorexx) is, where its decisions are made, the program and design format it writes, bound dialogs over mapped objects, the plugin host and secrets chain, how to build and test it, and what is open. Read before changing the designer, the ooRexx Object Editor (folder object-editor/ of the same branch), the Database Lab, or anything that reads a designer program.

sections.title: Integration: mapped objects, Database Lab, plugins
